name: Bybit Card
summary: A high-limit digital Mastercard supporting mobile wallets and real-time crypto-to-fiat conversion.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Full KYC, including proof of address, required
Virtual card only — no physical card

faq.question: Does the Bybit Card charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: No — there is no monthly fee. Card issuance is free.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the Bybit Card?
faq.answer: It charges about 0.5% on non-base-currency spending.

faq.question: What KYC does the Bybit Card require?
faq.answer: It requires a government ID plus proof of address.
